def derive_sw52_native(self):
        """Bind one project's Directory realm and exact CRM root policies to native reads."""
        self.sw52_native = {}
        if not self.sw52_native_mode:
            return
        if len([scope for scope in self.scopes if scope.startswith("projects/")]) != 1 or len(self.scopes) != 1:
            self.sw52_native = {scope: {"status": "unknown", "scope": scope, "reason": "multi_scope_directory_binding_unavailable"}
                for scope in self.scopes if scope.startswith("projects/")}
            return
        for scope in self.scopes:
            if not scope.startswith("projects/"):
                continue
            record = {"status": "unknown", "scope": scope, "reason": "hierarchy_unavailable"}
            self.sw52_native[scope] = record
            ancestry = self.ancestry.get(scope)
            request = self.ancestry_source_requests.get(scope)
            chain = self.hierarchy_chain(scope)
            if not isinstance(ancestry, list) or not request or chain is None or not chain or not chain[-1].startswith("organizations/"):
                continue
            if chain.count(chain[-1]) != 1 or any(not name.startswith("folders/") for name in chain[:-1]):
                continue
            names = [scope, *chain]
            project = self.collections.get(("project", scope))
            if not project or project.get("status") != "collected" or len(project.get("items", [])) != 1:
                record["reason"] = "project_identity_unavailable"
                continue
            project_row = project["items"][0]
            if (project_row.get("projectId") != scope.split("/", 1)[1] or
                    project_row.get("parent") != chain[0] or
                    not project.get("source_requests")):
                record["reason"] = "stale_project_parent"
                continue
            hierarchy_requests = {scope: project["source_requests"]}
            for position, name in enumerate(chain[:-1]):
                folder = self.collections.get(("folder", name))
                if (not folder or folder.get("status") != "collected" or
                        len(folder.get("items", [])) != 1 or
                        folder["items"][0].get("name") != name or
                        folder["items"][0].get("parent") != chain[position + 1] or
                        not folder.get("source_requests")):
                    record["reason"] = "stale_folder_parent"
                    break
                hierarchy_requests[name] = folder["source_requests"]
            if record["reason"] == "stale_folder_parent":
                continue
            organization = self.collections.get(("organization", chain[-1]))
            if not organization or organization.get("status") != "collected" or len(organization.get("items", [])) != 1:
                record["reason"] = "organization_identity_unavailable"
                continue
            org = organization["items"][0]
            if org.get("name") != chain[-1] or not isinstance(org.get("directoryCustomerId"), str) or not re.fullmatch(r"C[A-Za-z0-9_-]+", org["directoryCustomerId"]):
                record["reason"] = "organization_directory_customer_unavailable"
                continue
            policy_requests, policy_roots = {}, []
            for name in names:
                collection = self.collections.get(("iam_policy", name))
                roots = [row for row in (collection or {}).get("items", []) if row.get("name") == name and row.get("_provenance", {}).get("representation") == "full"]
                if (not collection or collection.get("status") not in ("collected", "empty") or
                        len(roots) != 1 or not collection.get("source_requests") or
                        not roots[0].get("_provenance", {}).get("source_requests") or
                        not isinstance(roots[0].get("bindings"), list)):
                    record["reason"] = "iam_root_read_incomplete"
                    break
                policy_requests[name] = roots[0]["_provenance"]["source_requests"]
                policy_roots.append({"origin_scope": name, "name": roots[0]["name"],
                    "bindings": copy.deepcopy(roots[0]["bindings"]),
                    "representation": "full", "source_requests": copy.deepcopy(policy_requests[name]),
                    "collection_source_requests": copy.deepcopy(collection["source_requests"])})
            else:
                record.update({"status": "collected", "reason": "", "organization": chain[-1],
                    "directory_customer": org["directoryCustomerId"], "iam_policy_resource_names": names,
                    "iam_policy_levels": [name.split("/", 1)[0][:-1] for name in names],
                    "ancestry_source_requests": [request], "iam_policy_source_requests": policy_requests,
                    "iam_policy_roots": policy_roots,
                    "organization_source_requests": organization.get("source_requests", []),
                    "hierarchy_source_requests": hierarchy_requests})

def _effective_audit_entries(item, index):
    coverage = get(item, "_coverage.effectiveAuditConfigs", dict)
    if (get(coverage, "status", str) != "collected"
            or get(coverage, "collection_status", str) != "collected"
            or get(coverage, "ancestry_known", bool) is not True
            or get(coverage, "missing_scopes", list)
            or get(coverage, "malformed_scopes", list)):
        raise Unavailable("effective ancestor audit policy incomplete")
    entries = list_of_objects(get(item, "effectiveAuditConfigs", list))
    source_refs = get(coverage, "source_requests", list)
    if not source_refs or any(not isinstance(ref, str) or not ref for ref in source_refs):
        raise Unavailable("effective audit source requests unavailable")
    scopes = [get(entry, "scope", str) for entry in entries]
    project = get(item, "name", str)
    inherited = get(index, "context.metadata.inherited_scopes", list)
    ancestors = get(coverage, "ancestor_scopes", list)
    if (not scopes or scopes[0] != project or len(scopes) != len(set(scopes))
            or scopes[1:] != ancestors
            or any(scope.startswith("organizations/") for scope in scopes[1:-1])
            or any(scope not in inherited or not re.fullmatch(r"(?:folders|organizations)/[0-9]+", scope)
                   for scope in scopes[1:])):
        raise Unavailable("effective audit ancestry foreign or incomplete")
    ledger = list_of_objects(get(index, "context.metadata.source_requests", list))
    by_ref = {}
    for row in ledger:
        ref = get(row, "id", str)
        if ref in by_ref:
            raise Unavailable("duplicate native request identity")
        by_ref[ref] = row
    def exact_read(ref, url):
        row = by_ref.get(ref)
        if (row is None or get(row, "method", str) != "POST"
                or get(row, "status", str) != "collected" or get(row, "url", str) != url):
            raise Unavailable("native audit policy request is unavailable or foreign")
    ancestry_refs = get(coverage, "ancestry_source_requests", list)
    if len(ancestry_refs) != 1 or not isinstance(ancestry_refs[0], str):
        raise Unavailable("native project ancestry request unavailable")
    exact_read(ancestry_refs[0],
               f"https://cloudresourcemanager.googleapis.com/v1/{project}:getAncestry")
    union_refs = set()
    for entry in entries:
        refs = get(entry, "source_requests", list)
        if not refs or any(not isinstance(ref, str) or ref not in source_refs for ref in refs):
            raise Unavailable("ancestor audit source request unavailable")
        policy_scope = get(entry, "scope", str)
        for ref in refs:
            exact_read(ref, f"https://cloudresourcemanager.googleapis.com/v3/{policy_scope}:getIamPolicy")
            union_refs.add(ref)
    if union_refs != set(source_refs) or len(union_refs) != len(source_refs):
        raise Unavailable("effective audit request union mismatch")
    return entries

def _inventory(index, kind, scope):
    envelopes = get(index, "collections", dict).get(kind)
    if not isinstance(envelopes, list) or len(envelopes) != 1:
        raise Unavailable("one exact scoped inventory is required: " + kind)
    envelope = get({"envelope": envelopes[0]}, "envelope", dict)
    if (get(envelope, "type", str) != kind or get(envelope, "scope", str) != scope
            or envelope.get("status") not in ("collected", "empty")
            or envelope.get("coverage_status") != envelope["status"] or envelope.get("error")):
        raise Unavailable("native inventory is incomplete, denied, malformed or foreign: " + kind)
    rows = list_of_objects(get(envelope, "items", list))
    if (envelope["status"] == "empty") != (not rows):
        raise Unavailable("empty native inventory contradicts its rows: " + kind)
    wrappers = list_of_objects(get(index, kind, list))
    projected = []
    for wrapper in wrappers:
        if (get(wrapper, "type", str) != kind or get(wrapper, "provider", str) != "gcp"
                or get(wrapper, "scope", str) != scope):
            raise Unavailable("native resource wrapper belongs to another subject: " + kind)
        row = get(wrapper, "data", dict)
        if get(row, "_provenance.scope", str) != scope:
            raise Unavailable("native provenance belongs to another project: " + kind)
        projected.append(row)
    encode = lambda value: json.dumps(value, sort_keys=True, separators=(",", ":"))
    if Counter(map(encode, rows)) != Counter(map(encode, projected)):
        raise Unavailable("native collection and resource projection disagree: " + kind)
    return projected

def _directory_user(item, index):
        """Validate the CRM customer join and the narrowly selected native user fields."""
        _member(item, index, 'workspace_user')
        scope = _scope(index)
        binding = get(item, '_directoryBinding', dict)
        if get(binding, 'status', str) != 'collected' or get(binding, 'scope', str) != scope:
            raise Unavailable('independent project Directory customer binding unavailable')
        customer = get(binding, 'customer', str)
        if (not re.fullmatch('C[A-Za-z0-9_-]+', customer) or get(item, 'customerId', str) != customer
                or get(item, 'directoryCustomer', str) != customer):
            raise Unavailable('Directory user belongs to a different customer')
        chain = _list(binding, 'chain')
        ledger = _list(index, 'context.metadata.source_requests')
        def read_proof(ref, url):
            matches = [row for row in ledger if row.get('id') == ref]
            if (len(matches) != 1 or matches[0].get('method') != 'GET'
                    or matches[0].get('url') != url or matches[0].get('status') != 'collected'):
                raise Unavailable('Directory native source request unavailable or foreign')
        current, seen = scope, set()
        if not chain or len(chain) > 32:
            raise Unavailable('Directory hierarchy chain unavailable')
        for position, row in enumerate(chain):
            if row.get('requested') != current or current in seen:
                raise Unavailable('Directory hierarchy chain inconsistent')
            seen.add(current)
            read_proof(get(row, 'source_request', str), 'https://cloudresourcemanager.googleapis.com/v3/' + current)
            name = get(row, 'name', str)
            if position == 0:
                if (not re.fullmatch('projects/[1-9][0-9]*', name)
                        or scope not in (name, 'projects/' + str(row.get('projectId', '')))):
                    raise Unavailable('Directory project identity inconsistent')
            elif name != current:
                raise Unavailable('Directory ancestor identity inconsistent')
            if position == len(chain) - 1:
                if (not re.fullmatch('organizations/[1-9][0-9]*', current)
                        or row.get('directoryCustomerId') != customer or binding.get('organization') != current):
                    raise Unavailable('Directory organization customer binding inconsistent')
            else:
                current = get(row, 'parent', str)
                if not re.fullmatch('(?:folders|organizations)/[1-9][0-9]*', current):
                    raise Unavailable('Directory parent unavailable')
        projection = get(item, '_coverage.directoryProjection', dict)
        if (get(projection, 'status', str) != 'collected' or projection.get('projection') != 'full'
                or projection.get('viewType') != 'admin_view'):
            raise Unavailable('Directory user field projection unavailable')
        refs = get(projection, 'source_requests', list)
        if not refs:
            raise Unavailable('Directory user source request unavailable')
        for ref in refs:
            read_proof(ref, 'https://admin.googleapis.com/admin/directory/v1/users')
        return customer, projection

def quote(string, safe='/', encoding=None, errors=None):
    """quote('abc def') -> 'abc%20def'

    Each part of a URL, e.g. the path info, the query, etc., has a
    different set of reserved characters that must be quoted. The
    quote function offers a cautious (not minimal) way to quote a
    string for most of these parts.

    RFC 3986 Uniform Resource Identifier (URI): Generic Syntax lists
    the following (un)reserved characters.

    unreserved    = ALPHA / DIGIT / "-" / "." / "_" / "~"
    reserved      = gen-delims / sub-delims
    gen-delims    = ":" / "/" / "?" / "#" / "[" / "]" / "@"
    sub-delims    = "!" / "$" / "&" / "'" / "(" / ")"
                  / "*" / "+" / "," / ";" / "="

    Each of the reserved characters is reserved in some component of a URL,
    but not necessarily in all of them.

    The quote function %-escapes all characters that are neither in the
    unreserved chars ("always safe") nor the additional chars set via the
    safe arg.

    The default for the safe arg is '/'. The character is reserved, but in
    typical usage the quote function is being called on a path where the
    existing slash characters are to be preserved.

    Python 3.7 updates from using RFC 2396 to RFC 3986 to quote URL strings.
    Now, "~" is included in the set of unreserved characters.

    string and safe may be either str or bytes objects. encoding and errors
    must not be specified if string is a bytes object.

    The optional encoding and errors parameters specify how to deal with
    non-ASCII characters, as accepted by the str.encode method.
    By default, encoding='utf-8' (characters are encoded with UTF-8), and
    errors='strict' (unsupported characters raise a UnicodeEncodeError).
    """
    if isinstance(string, str):
        if not string:
            return string
        if encoding is None:
            encoding = 'utf-8'
        if errors is None:
            errors = 'strict'
        string = string.encode(encoding, errors)
    else:
        if encoding is not None:
            raise TypeError("quote() doesn't support 'encoding' for bytes")
        if errors is not None:
            raise TypeError("quote() doesn't support 'errors' for bytes")
    return quote_from_bytes(string, safe)

def gcp_effective_boolean_constraint(index, constraint):
    """Resolve an effective boolean policy only for this exact project/constraint.

    Imported snapshots retain the provider's policy name independently of the
    collection wrapper. A numeric project alias needs the producer's CRM read
    binding and its matching request trace; the policy payload is not an alias
    authority.
    """
    import re
    from .facts import Unavailable, complete_items
    envelopes = index.get("collections", {}).get("org_policy_effective", [])
    if not isinstance(envelopes, list) or len(envelopes) != 1 or not isinstance(envelopes[0], dict):
        raise Unavailable("effective org policy scope ambiguous")
    scope = envelopes[0].get("scope")
    if not isinstance(scope, str) or not re.fullmatch(r"projects/[^/:%]+", scope):
        raise Unavailable("effective org policy project scope unavailable")
    context = index.get("context")
    if (not isinstance(context, dict) or context.get("scope") != scope
            or context.get("provider") != "gcp"):
        raise Unavailable("effective org policy context scope mismatch")
    policies = [p for p in complete_items(index, "org_policy_effective") if get(p, "constraint", str) == constraint]
    if len(policies) != 1:
        raise Unavailable("effective org policy missing or ambiguous: " + constraint)
    policy = policies[0]
    suffix = "/policies/" + constraint
    name = get(policy, "name", str)
    if not isinstance(name, str) or not name.endswith(suffix):
        raise Unavailable("effective org policy name/constraint mismatch")
    parent = name[:-len(suffix)]
    provenance = optional(policy, "_provenance", {}, dict)
    if not isinstance(provenance, dict) or (optional(provenance, "scope", None, str) not in (None, scope)):
        raise Unavailable("effective org policy provenance scope mismatch")
    alias = optional(policy, "project_alias", None, dict)
    if parent == scope:
        if alias is not None:
            raise Unavailable("unexpected effective org policy alias")
    else:
        if (not re.fullmatch(r"projects/[1-9][0-9]*", parent)
                or not isinstance(alias, dict)
                or get(alias, "requested_scope", str) != scope
                or get(alias, "project_id", str) != scope.split("/", 1)[1]
                or get(alias, "canonical_name", str) != parent
                or get(alias, "source_operation", str) != "projects.get"
                or not isinstance(get(alias, "source_request", str), str)
                or not get(alias, "source_request", str)):
            raise Unavailable("effective org policy project alias unresolved")
        requests = optional(get(context, "metadata", dict), "source_requests", [], list)
        if not isinstance(requests, list):
            raise Unavailable("effective org policy alias request trace missing")
        expected_url = "https://cloudresourcemanager.googleapis.com/v3/" + scope
        matches = [entry for entry in requests if isinstance(entry, dict)
                   and get(entry, "id", str) == get(alias, "source_request", str)]
        if (len(matches) != 1 or get(matches[0], "url", str) != expected_url
                or get(matches[0], "method", str) != "GET"
                or get(matches[0], "scope", str) != scope
                or get(matches[0], "status", str) != "collected"):
            raise Unavailable("effective org policy alias request unverified")
    # An evaluated Policy with no spec/rules means nothing is set anywhere in
    # the hierarchy: a boolean constraint is then not enforced.
    spec = optional(policy, "spec", {}, dict)
    rules = list_of_objects(optional(spec, "rules", [], list))
    if any(set(rule) - {"enforce", "_coverage"} or set(optional(rule, "_coverage", {}, dict)) - {"enforce"} for rule in rules):
        raise Unavailable("conditional or non-boolean effective org policy rule: " + constraint)
    values = {get(rule, "enforce", bool) for rule in rules}
    if len(values) > 1:
        raise Unavailable("contradictory effective org policy rules: " + constraint)
    return values == {True}, name

gcp-compliance.control.cmek_rotation_one.title: Check that CMEK rotation policy is in place and is sufficiently short

query_source_excerpts.text:
query "kms_key_rotated_within_100_day" {
  sql = <<-EOQ
    select
      self_link as resource,
      case
        when "primary" ->> 'state' = 'DESTROYED' then 'skip'
        when "primary" ->> 'state' = 'DESTROY_SCHEDULED' then 'skip'
        when "primary" ->> 'state' = 'DISABLED' then 'skip'
        when split_part(rotation_period, 's', 1) :: int <= 8640000 then 'ok'
        else 'alarm'
      end as status,
      case
        when "primary" ->> 'state' = 'DESTROYED' then title || ' is destroyed.'
        when "primary" ->> 'state' = 'DESTROY_SCHEDULED' then title || ' is scheduled for deletion.'
        when "primary" ->> 'state' = 'DISABLED' then title || ' is disabled.'
        when rotation_period is null then title || ' in ' || key_ring_name || ' requires manual rotation.'
        else key_ring_name || ' ' || title || ' rotation period set for ' || (split_part(rotation_period, 's', 1) :: int)/86400 || ' day(s).'
      end as reason
      ${local.tag_dimensions_sql}
      ${local.common_dimensions_sql}
    from
      gcp_kms_key;
  EOQ
}

gcp-compliance.control.denylist_public_u.title: Prevent public users from having access to resources via IAM

query_source_excerpts.text:
query "iam_user_denylist_public" {
  sql = <<-EOQ
    with user_with_acces as (
      select
        distinct project
      from
        gcp_iam_policy,
        jsonb_array_elements(bindings) as b,
        jsonb_array_elements_text(b -> 'members') as m
      where
        m like 'allUsers'
    )
    select
      a.project as resource,
      case
        when b.project is null then 'ok'
        else 'alarm'
      end as status,
      case
        when b.project is null then 'No public users have access to resources via IAM.'
        else 'Public users have access to resources via IAM.'
      end as reason
      ${replace(local.common_dimensions_qualifier_global_sql, "__QUALIFIER__", "a.")}
    from
      gcp_iam_policy as a
      left join user_with_acces as b on a.project = b.project;
  EOQ
}

query "bigquery_dataset_restrict_gmail" {
  sql = <<-EOQ
    with dataset_access as (
    select
      distinct dataset_id
      from
      gcp_bigquery_dataset,
      jsonb_array_elements(access) as a
      where
      a ->> 'userByEmail' like '%gmail.com'
    )
    select
        a.dataset_id as resource,
      case
        when b.dataset_id is null then 'ok'
        else 'alarm'
      end as status,
      case
        when b.dataset_id is null
          then a.dataset_id || ' enforces corporate domain by banning gmail.com addresses access.'
        else
        a.dataset_id || ' does not enforce corporate domain by banning gmail.com addresses access.'
      end as reason
      ${replace(local.tag_dimensions_qualifier_sql, "__QUALIFIER__", "a.")}
      ${replace(local.common_dimensions_qualifier_sql, "__QUALIFIER__", "a.")}
    from
      gcp_bigquery_dataset as a
      left join dataset_access as b on a.dataset_id = b.dataset_id;
  EOQ
}

from prowler.lib.check.models import Check, Check_Report_GCP
from prowler.providers.gcp.services.bigquery.bigquery_client import bigquery_client


class bigquery_dataset_cmk_encryption(Check):
    def execute(self) -> Check_Report_GCP:
        findings = []
        for dataset in bigquery_client.datasets:
            report = Check_Report_GCP(metadata=self.metadata(), resource=dataset)
            report.status = "PASS"
            report.status_extended = f"Dataset {dataset.name} is encrypted with Customer-Managed Keys (CMKs)."
            if not dataset.cmk_encryption:
                report.status = "FAIL"
                report.status_extended = f"Dataset {dataset.name} is not encrypted with Customer-Managed Keys (CMKs)."
            findings.append(report)

        return findings

query_source_excerpts.text:
from prowler.lib.check.models import Check, Check_Report_GCP
from prowler.providers.gcp.services.cloudsql.cloudsql_client import cloudsql_client


class cloudsql_instance_high_availability_enabled(Check):
    """Check that Cloud SQL primary instances are configured for high availability.

    Verifies that each Cloud SQL primary instance has `availabilityType` set to
    `REGIONAL`, which provisions a standby replica in a different zone within
    the same region and enables automatic failover on zone-level outages. Read
    replicas are skipped because they inherit availability from their primary.
    """

    def execute(self) -> list[Check_Report_GCP]:
        """Execute the high availability check across all Cloud SQL instances.

        Returns:
            A list of `Check_Report_GCP` findings, one per Cloud SQL primary
            instance. Status is `PASS` when `availability_type == "REGIONAL"`
            and `FAIL` otherwise.
        """
        findings = []
        for instance in cloudsql_client.instances:
            if instance.instance_type != "CLOUD_SQL_INSTANCE":
                continue
            report = Check_Report_GCP(metadata=self.metadata(), resource=instance)
            if instance.availability_type == "REGIONAL":
                report.status = "PASS"
                report.status_extended = (
                    f"Database instance {instance.name} has high availability "
                    f"(REGIONAL) configured."
                )
            else:
                report.status = "FAIL"
                report.status_extended = (
                    f"Database instance {instance.name} does not have high "
                    f"availability configured (current: "
                    f"{instance.availability_type})."
                )
            findings.append(report)
        return findings

from prowler.lib.check.models import Check, Check_Report_GCP
from prowler.providers.gcp.services.cloudstorage.cloudstorage_client import (
    cloudstorage_client,
)


class cloudstorage_bucket_lifecycle_management_enabled(Check):
    """Ensure Cloud Storage buckets have lifecycle management enabled with at least one valid rule.

    Reports PASS if a bucket has at least one valid lifecycle rule
    (with a supported action and condition), otherwise FAIL.

    """

    def execute(self) -> list[Check_Report_GCP]:
        """Run the lifecycle management check for each Cloud Storage bucket.

        Returns:
            list[Check_Report_GCP]: Results for all evaluated buckets.
        """

        findings = []
        for bucket in cloudstorage_client.buckets:
            report = Check_Report_GCP(metadata=self.metadata(), resource=bucket)
            report.status = "FAIL"
            report.status_extended = (
                f"Bucket {bucket.name} does not have lifecycle management enabled."
            )

            rules = bucket.lifecycle_rules

            if rules:
                valid_rules = []
                for rule in rules:
                    action_type = rule.get("action", {}).get("type")
                    condition = rule.get("condition")
                    if action_type and condition:
                        valid_rules.append(rule)

                if valid_rules:
                    report.status = "PASS"
                    report.status_extended = f"Bucket {bucket.name} has lifecycle management enabled with {len(valid_rules)} valid rule(s)."
                else:
                    report.status = "FAIL"
                    report.status_extended = f"Bucket {bucket.name} has lifecycle rules configured but none are valid."

            findings.append(report)
        return findings

class iam_no_service_roles_at_project_level(Check):

        for binding in cloudresourcemanager_client.bindings:

                metadata=self.metadata(),
                resource=binding,
                resource_id=binding.role,
                resource_name=binding.role if binding.role else "Service Role",

                "roles/iam.serviceAccountUser",

                report.status_extended = f"IAM Users assigned to service role '{binding.role}' at project level {binding.project_id}."

                findings.append(report)

        for project in cloudresourcemanager_client.project_ids:
            if project not in failed_projects:
                report = Check_Report_GCP(
                    metadata=self.metadata(),
                    resource=cloudresourcemanager_client.projects[project],
                    project_id=project,
                    location=cloudresourcemanager_client.region,
                )
                report.status = "PASS"
                report.status_extended = f"No IAM Users assigned to service roles at project level {project}."
                findings.append(report)
        return findings

query_source_excerpts.text:
from urllib.parse import urlparse

from prowler.lib.check.models import Check, Check_Report_GCP
from prowler.providers.gcp.services.iam.iam_client import iam_client

# OIDC issuers whose tokens are minted for many independent tenants (any GitHub
# repository, any GitLab project, any Google account, ...). A provider that
# trusts one of these without an ``attributeCondition`` accepts identities
# outside the operator's control, so omitting the condition genuinely expands
# trust. A dedicated, single-tenant issuer only vends tokens to the operator's
# own workloads, so an attribute condition there is defense-in-depth rather than
# a requirement (see Google's guidance for GitHub and other shared issuers).
MULTI_TENANT_OIDC_ISSUER_HOSTS = {
    "token.actions.githubusercontent.com",  # GitHub Actions (any repository)
    "gitlab.com",  # GitLab.com SaaS (any project)
    "accounts.google.com",  # any Google account
    "app.terraform.io",  # HCP Terraform (any organization)
}


def _is_multi_tenant_issuer(issuer_uri: str) -> bool:
    """Return True when the OIDC issuer is a known multi-tenant/shared issuer."""
    if not issuer_uri:
        return False
    # hostname lowercases and strips port/userinfo (gitlab.com:443, user@host);
    # fall back to the raw string for bare hosts without a scheme.
    host = urlparse(issuer_uri).hostname or issuer_uri.lower()
    return host in MULTI_TENANT_OIDC_ISSUER_HOSTS


class iam_workload_identity_pool_provider_attribute_condition(Check):
    """Ensure WIF providers trusting a multi-tenant issuer enforce an attribute condition.

    A workload identity pool provider that trusts a multi-tenant issuer (GitHub
    Actions, GitLab.com, ...) without an ``attributeCondition`` accepts every
    external identity that issuer can mint. An attacker controlling any tenant on
    that platform can then authenticate through the provider and exchange tokens
    for federated credentials, surviving credential rotation. Providers that
    enforce an attribute condition, that trust a dedicated single-tenant issuer,
    that are not OIDC-based, that are disabled/inactive, or whose parent pool is
    disabled are reported as PASS.
    """

    def execute(self) -> list[Check_Report_GCP]:
        """Evaluate the attribute condition of each Workload Identity provider.

        Returns:
            list[Check_Report_GCP]: One report per workload identity pool
            provider. FAIL for active providers that trust a multi-tenant issuer
            without an attribute condition; PASS for providers that enforce one,
            trust a dedicated issuer, are not OIDC-based, or are
            disabled/inactive.
        """
        findings = []
        for provider in iam_client.workload_identity_pool_providers:
            report = Check_Report_GCP(
                metadata=self.metadata(),
                resource=provider,
                resource_id=provider.name,
                resource_name=provider.display_name or provider.id,
                location="global",
            )
            if provider.pool_disabled:
                report.status = "PASS"
                report.status_extended = (
                    f"Workload Identity Federation provider {provider.id} belongs "
                    f"to the disabled pool {provider.pool_id}, which cannot vend "
                    "credentials."
                )
            elif provider.disabled or provider.state != "ACTIVE":
                report.status = "PASS"
                report.status_extended = (
                    f"Workload Identity Federation provider {provider.id} in pool "
                    f"{provider.pool_id} is not active and cannot vend credentials."
                )
            elif provider.attribute_condition:
                report.status = "PASS"
                report.status_extended = (
                    f"Workload Identity Federation provider {provider.id} in pool "
                    f"{provider.pool_id} enforces an attribute condition."
                )
            elif _is_multi_tenant_issuer(provider.issuer_uri):
                report.status = "FAIL"
                report.status_extended = (
                    f"Workload Identity Federation provider {provider.id} in pool "
                    f"{provider.pool_id} trusts the multi-tenant issuer "
                    f"{provider.issuer_uri} without an attribute condition, so any "
                    "identity from that issuer can authenticate through this provider."
                )
            elif provider.provider_type != "oidc":
                report.status = "PASS"
                report.status_extended = (
                    f"Workload Identity Federation provider {provider.id} in pool "
                    f"{provider.pool_id} is not an OIDC provider trusting a "
                    "multi-tenant issuer; an attribute condition is recommended as "
                    "defense-in-depth but not required."
                )
            else:
                report.status = "PASS"
                report.status_extended = (
                    f"Workload Identity Federation provider {provider.id} in pool "
                    f"{provider.pool_id} trusts a dedicated issuer; an attribute "
                    "condition is recommended as defense-in-depth but not required."
                )
            findings.append(report)

        return findings
